name: Abádszalók (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and dark purple in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Abádszalók: a green and purple shield with a yellow eagle and two white fish.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
